productConcept.name: Deckle & Thread
productConcept.description: A hand papermaking and bookbinding studio specializing in handmade cotton papers, custom-bound journals, limited-edition artist books, and workshops in traditional paper and book arts.
productConcept.rationale: The book-themed design system with Cormorant Garamond serif headings, paper-drift easing, generous 112px chapter spacing, and 960px book-page width proportions maps directly to a craft bookbinding studio. The name combines two core bookmaking processes: the deckle (frame for forming paper sheets) and thread (sewn binding).

animationDecision: motion-tokens — motion system has substantial durations (0.75s-1.875s), paper-drift easing cubic-bezier(0.15, 0.85, 0.25, 1.0), and scroll-reveal patterns in concept_by_video.md
